craft_notes: Sthāyin: grant-joy. NO ajñaḥ (asmāt starts). Close: doubtlessness. Rejected: inventing a subject — killed: asmāt kept.

lines: What he desires, desires, swiftly shall he gain;
from this to direct sight he goes — all-knowingness, and no doubt.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt asmāt pratyakṣatāmeti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |

reads_against.argmap: Whatever desires, them quickly got; from this to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
c1_essence: Desires quickly got; unknowing to direct sight, no doubt.
